Ln 1823 Josef Lobmeyr senior founds the company in Vienna's Wethburg-gasse and soon becomes purveyor to the Imperial Court. LOBMEYR pro-vides handmade and mouthblown champagne coolers for auction. The shape has been designed by Sebas-tian Menschhorn. Each of them was exclusively designed by the designers
Vivienne Westwood, Angela Missoni and Roberto Cavalli and cut and en-graved at the LOBMEYR work- shops. The coolers are limited to one

piece.
